findings.F1: When the forecast was on, the coin did worse than usual: on 1036 grid cells it ran -0.67 % below normal drift over the next 10 days, against +1.06 % on the 655 cells where it was off; this held on every coin (on: -1.43 % BTC, -1.42 % ETH, -0.73 % ZEC; off: +1.79 %, +1.91 %, +1.31 %).
findings.F2: The move after the situation is graded the opposite way from the tested idea. By 28-day return quintile, the unusual 10-day move rises from -1.57 % (deepest falls, t -1.82, 252 cases) to +1.26 % (largest rises). The pooled slope is +1.23 % per standard deviation of the 28-day return (t 2.87, 1259 cases), +1.36 % for the 10-day return (t 3.39, 1547) and +1.24 % for the position in the 60-day range (t 2.27, 827).
findings.F3: The book's deepest fall is 47.9 % over 261 days (windows w12 to w14). The coins fell 79.6 % over the same stretch, so the book stayed long through a long decline. It held a mean position of 0.45 on forecast-on cells against 0.07 off, which gives a Calmar of 0.07.
findings.F4: The book earned 0.021 % a day against the coins' 0.119 %, with a correlation of 0.65. What it earns is a fraction of the coin's drift, because its timing is negative (F1). This is why it trails holding by 0.30 in Sharpe and misses the 0.05 % daily gain.
findings.F5: The tested idea is too small to pay: its unusual move is -0.92 % per case over 10 days and its total move is +0.26 %, 1.3 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade. The opposite side is large: among 28-day rises, the middle and top terciles had unusual moves of +1.31 % and +1.66 % (strength 0.087 and 0.104, total +2.5 % and +2.9 %), about 7 to 9 times the cost.
findings.F6: The continuation is not stable. The 28-day slope is t 3.48 in the later windows (635 cases) and t -1.10 in the earlier ones (624 cases). By coin it is strong only on ZEC (t 2.86); BTC, LTC and XRP are near 0, and XMR is negative (t -0.95).

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 28-day rise, the higher its return over the next 10 days; the deeper its 28-day fall, the lower its return over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would lean long a coin after a strong 28-day rise and refuse to buy one after a deep 28-day fall, rather than bet on a rebound.
ideas.name: 28-day momentum over 10 days

ideas.idea: The higher a coin's close sits in its 60-day close range and the larger its 10-day rise, the higher its return over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would favour longs in coins trading near their 60-day high after a 10-day rise, and avoid longs near the 60-day low.
ideas.name: near-high recent-rise continuation
